homeAbout.p1: HAL Offshore Limited is a premier, International turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) solution provider for the Oil and Gas sector. Founded in 1998 as an EPC arm of the multi-Billion dollar corporate conglomerate, the MMG Group, we have built a multi-decade legacy of engineering excellence.
homeAbout.p2: We are structurally and financially equipped to undertake mid-to-large-scale EPC campaigns, managing individual project values across a wide range of capital scales. Our capabilities span the entire execution spectrum—ranging from standalone brownfield retrofits to major, multi-location topside installations across both onshore and offshore environments.
homeAbout.p3: Operating in strict compliance to standards ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018, Quality and safety form the absolute cornerstone of our execution model. Our track record features multiple milestone achievements, including millions of cumulative safe man-hours executed with zero Lost Time Injuries (LTI) across complex brownfield & greenfield environments.
homeAbout.p4: Our operational strength is anchored by a highly versatile workforce of over 1500 technical professionals and domain experts. Our multi-disciplinary talent pool bridges engineering designers, procurement specialists, construction superintendents, qualified QA/QC inspectors, and rigorous HSE officers. Exceling through continuous technical upskilling, the Team has delivered complex multi-million dollar projects ahead of schedule, maintaining an exceptional customer satisfaction, building long-term trust Instinctively.
homeAbout.p5: From initial concept to final commissioning, HAL Offshore is the trusted partner for managing and executing integrated EPC and LSTK portfolios safely, reliably, on-time and with absolute precision.
homeAbout.p6: To make, sell & deliver world-class profitable products and services that satisfy our consumers and deliver sustainable and profitable growth through passionate and empowered associates who are focused on innovation, quality, and efficiency while remaining committed to the environment and community they operate in.

aboutPage.chairman.title: Chairman's message
aboutPage.chairman.name: Mr. Sanjeev Agarwal
aboutPage.chairman.photoAlt: Portrait of Mr. Sanjeev Agarwal, Chairman of HAL Offshore Limited
aboutPage.chairman.p1: HAL was built on a simple promise: deliver complex offshore work with clarity, discipline, and respect for people and the environment. That promise still guides every campaign we run and every facility we commission.
aboutPage.chairman.p2: As India’s energy mix evolves, we continue to invest in safe marine spreads, capable teams, and reliable delivery—so our clients can focus on production while we own execution risk offshore and onshore.
aboutPage.chairman.p3: Thank you for your trust in HAL.
aboutPage.viceChairman.title: Vice Chairman's message
aboutPage.viceChairman.name: Mr. Anant Agarwal
aboutPage.viceChairman.photoAlt: Portrait of Mr. Anant Agarwal, Vice Chairman of HAL Offshore Limited
aboutPage.viceChairman.p1: HAL's growth rests on disciplined execution and long-term partnerships with India's leading energy operators. We combine engineering depth with marine capability to deliver complex projects safely and on schedule.
aboutPage.viceChairman.p2: As Vice Chairman, I focus on strengthening our project governance, expanding our EPC and marine service footprint, and building teams that can scale with our clients' ambitions across offshore and onshore.
aboutPage.viceChairman.p3: We remain committed to integrity, operational excellence, and the trust our partners place in HAL every day.
aboutPage.ceo.title: CEO & COO's Message
aboutPage.ceo.name: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
aboutPage.ceo.role: Chief Executive Officer & Chief Operating Officer
aboutPage.ceo.photoAlt: Portrait of Mr. Vineet Agarwal, CEO & COO of HAL Offshore Limited
aboutPage.ceo.p1: HAL continues to scale dependable delivery for Indian oil and gas—combining engineering depth, marine execution, and the discipline our clients expect on live assets and brownfield campaigns.
aboutPage.ceo.p2: My focus is straightforward: give teams clear accountability, invest in safe marine spreads and capable supervisors, and keep every programme transparent from concept through commissioning and into operations.
aboutPage.ceo.p3: We welcome partners who value integrity as much as uptime—and who see execution risk as something to own, not pass along.
aboutPage.journey.title: Our journey..
aboutPage.journey.y1998.body: O&M contract for ONGC vessels MSV Samudra Suraksha and DSV Samudra Prabha.
aboutPage.journey.y2004.body: Established EPC with the first offshore EPC job: revamping of fuel gas skids for TG & PGC (Train A & B) at NQO & NQG platforms in Mumbai High.
aboutPage.journey.y2004.note: Continuing with multiple offshore brownfield jobs to date.
aboutPage.journey.y2008.body: Acquired a fabrication yard in Navi Mumbai.
aboutPage.journey.y2016.body: First onshore project: supply and installation of gas dehydration units at eight ONGC locations with O&M for five years. Project value USD 90 million.
aboutPage.journey.y2016.note: Continuing multiple onshore surface facility projects to date.
aboutPage.journey.y2020.body: First refinery project: Delayed Coker Unit; continuing with multiple refinery projects to date.
aboutPage.milestones.title: Our Journey And Milestones
aboutPage.milestones.lead: Selected markers from decades of offshore and EPC delivery.
aboutPage.milestones.m1.title: The Beginning
aboutPage.milestones.m1.body: HAL Offshore entered the EPC sector with its first offshore EPC project— Fuel Gas Skids for TG & PGC (Train A & B) at the NQO & NQG platforms in Mumbai High. This marked the beginning of a long-standing partnership with India's offshore oil & gas industry.
aboutPage.milestones.m2.title: Building Offshore Expertise
aboutPage.milestones.m2.body: Successfully executed numerous offshore brownfield EPC projects for ONGC, including process unit revamps, modifications, and long-term Operations & Maintenance (O&M) services, establishing a strong reputation in offshore engineering.
aboutPage.milestones.m3.title: Expanding Onshore
aboutPage.milestones.m3.body: Awarded the first major onshore project (Build Own & Operate basis) for Gas Dehydration Units across eight ONGC locations, including five years of O&M. This marked HAL's successful expansion into onshore process facilities.
aboutPage.milestones.m4.title: Strengthening Presence in North-East India
aboutPage.milestones.m4.body: Secured the EPC contract from ONGC and followed by Oil India in 2017, marking the beginning of a strong presence in Assam with multiple projects for both ONGC and OIL India Limited.
aboutPage.milestones.m5.title: Advanced Well Injection Technologies
aboutPage.milestones.m5.body: Successfully executed the Polymer Injection Project for ONGC Viraj, followed by long-term Operations & Maintenance, demonstrating expertise in enhanced oil recovery facilities.
aboutPage.milestones.m6.title: Greenfield Process Facilities
aboutPage.milestones.m6.body: Completed multiple greenfield surface processing facilities, including:
aboutPage.milestones.m6.item2: Gas Gathering station and Gas Processing Plant
aboutPage.milestones.m7.title: Sustained Growth
aboutPage.milestones.m7.body: Expanded the project portfolio with multiple onshore processing plants, compressor stations, and surface facilities for leading clients including ONGC, OIL India, IGGL, and Vedanta.
aboutPage.milestones.m7.body2: Awarded with multiple construction and composite LSTK contracts for leading energy companies, including GAIL, EIL, Indian Oil Corporation (IOCL), Haldia Petrochemicals, and MRPL, further strengthening HAL Offshore's capabilities across oil & gas, petrochemicals, and refinery sectors.
aboutPage.milestones.m8.title: Entering the Refinery Sector
aboutPage.milestones.m8.body: Awarded the company's first refinery process EPC project—the Delayed Coker Unit (DCU) revamping, marking a significant diversification into the downstream refining sector.
aboutPage.milestones.m9.title: Diversification into Metals
aboutPage.milestones.m9.body: Expanded into the metals sector with the first Aluminium Refinery project for NALCO, strengthening HAL's capabilities beyond the oil & gas industry.
aboutPage.milestones.m10.title: Today
aboutPage.milestones.m10.body: With over two decades of EPC excellence, HAL Offshore has evolved into a trusted EPC Company delivering offshore revamping projects, onshore processing facilities, gas compressor stations, refinery process packages, metal and industrial projects, serving leading clients across the energy and process industries.

aboutPage.leadership.title: Leadership
aboutPage.leadership.lead: Driven by decades of industry expertise and a vision for engineering excellence.
aboutPage.leadership.sanjeev.name: Mr. Sanjeev Agrawal
aboutPage.leadership.sanjeev.photoAlt: Portrait of Mr. Sanjeev Agrawal, Group Chairman, MMG Group
aboutPage.leadership.sanjeev.p.1: Mr. Sanjeev Agrawal, Group Chairman, and Promoter of MMG Group is an illustrious businessman with over three decades of experience in managing diversified business growth and strategic expansions. He is a Master in Commerce from India and a MBA from Atlanta, USA.
aboutPage.leadership.sanjeev.p.2: Mr. Agrawal was instrumental in setting up large-scale beverage manufacturing businesses through franchisee agreements with The Coca-Cola Company in key locations such as Kanpur, Sahibabad, Greater Noida, and Rourkela. Under his leadership, the Group was able to diversify into various businesses such as Hospitality, Education, Oil & Gas Services (with ONGC), and Food Beverages.
aboutPage.leadership.sanjeev.p.3: Under the mentorship of his visionary father, Mr. Agrawal was able to transform MMG Group into a diversified conglomerate. Mr. Agrawal is known for his strategic leadership, entrepreneurial skills, and creating sustainable businesses.
aboutPage.leadership.sanjeev.p.4: Mr. Agrawal is passionate about giving back to society through various causes for the betterment of the nation. He was an active participant in various social causes such as public health, education, and community development, besides contributing to various thought processes on socio-economic development through various media outlets. He holds key positions in leading industry associations such as PHDCCI, besides various other key positions in various advisory committees, which speaks volumes about his stature in the international affairs.
aboutPage.leadership.sanjeev.p.5: Mr. Agrawal believes in inclusive growth for the betterment of the nation through various initiatives for the growth of businesses in sync with the growth of the nation.
aboutPage.leadership.anant.name: Mr. Anant Agarwal
aboutPage.leadership.anant.photoAlt: Portrait of Mr. Anant Agarwal, Group Vice Chairman, MMG Group
aboutPage.leadership.anant.p.1: Mr. Anant Agarwal is the Group Vice Chairman of MMG Group and Connaught Plaza Restaurants Limited (CPRL), recognized as a dynamic business leader driving growth and transformation across consumer-focused industries. He has been instrumental in expanding the Group's presence in Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), beverage bottling, and allied consumer businesses, establishing MMG Group as a prominent market player.
aboutPage.leadership.anant.p.2: He oversees a diverse portfolio, including McDonald's operations in North and East India and Moon Beverages, a leading Coca-Cola bottling partner. Under his leadership, the Group has witnessed significant growth through a strong focus on digital transformation, customer experience, and sustainability. He played a key role in revitalizing McDonald's operations in these regions, strengthening brand positioning and operational performance.
aboutPage.leadership.anant.p.3: Mr. Agarwal is known for his sharp understanding of consumer behavior, market trends, and business strategy. His leadership approach combines long-term vision with operational excellence, enabling consistent value creation across business verticals.
aboutPage.leadership.anant.p.4: He holds a Master's degree in Innovation and Entrepreneurship from the University of Warwick, UK, and brings a global perspective complemented by deep insights into the Indian market. His forward-thinking leadership continues to position MMG Group for sustained growth, innovation, and industry leadership.
aboutPage.leadership.vineet.name: Mr. Vineet Agrawal
aboutPage.leadership.vineet.role: CEO, HAL Energy Company LLC, KSA
aboutPage.leadership.vineet.role2: CEO, HAL Offshore Limited, Mumbai, India
aboutPage.leadership.vineet.photoAlt: Portrait of Mr. Vineet Agrawal, CEO, HAL Energy Company LLC and HAL Offshore Limited
aboutPage.leadership.vineet.p.1: Mr. Vineet Agrawal is a Chemical Engineer (B.Tech, Honours – MNIT Jaipur, 1996) and a seasoned industry leader with over three decades of experience across manufacturing and the Oil & Gas EPC sector. He has played a pivotal role in establishing and strengthening the EPC business of HAL Offshore Limited.
aboutPage.leadership.vineet.p.2: Beginning his career in chemical manufacturing, he built a strong technical foundation before transitioning into the EPC domain, where he brings over 25 years of extensive experience. His expertise encompasses engineering, project execution, and operational excellence within complex industrial environments.
aboutPage.leadership.vineet.p.3: Mr. Agrawal is known for his balanced techno-commercial acumen and leadership, contributing significantly to organizational growth and successful project delivery in the oil and gas sector.
aboutPage.leadership.musalli.name: Mr. Musalli Almuammar
aboutPage.leadership.musalli.role: Chairman, HAL Energy Company LLC, KSA
aboutPage.leadership.musalli.photoAlt: Portrait of Mr. Musalli Almuammar, Chairman, HAL Energy Company LLC, KSA
aboutPage.leadership.musalli.p.1: Mr. Musalli Almuammar is a distinguished Saudi business leader, board member, and legal advisor with extensive experience across oil & gas, construction, digital transformation, and strategic investments. He is widely recognized for his role in structuring high-value partnerships and enabling international organizations to successfully enter and operate within the Saudi market.
aboutPage.leadership.musalli.p.2: With deep expertise in corporate law, regulatory frameworks, and board governance, Mr. Almuammar has held several key leadership and board positions. Beyond his corporate accomplishments, Mr. Almuammar brings notable leadership experience from the sports sector. He has served as President of Al Nassr Football Club and Chairman of the Saudi Pro League, where he led key governance and institutional transformation initiatives.
aboutPage.leadership.musalli.p.3: Mr. Almuammar is recognized for his strategic insight, governance expertise, and ability to bridge international business standards with local market dynamics.

offshoreEpc.project.gas-compressors-bcpb: Retrofitting of gas compressors, BCPB-2 platform

Retrofitting of the existing gas compression system at BCPB-2 platform to operate at a lower suction pressure of 10 kg/cm² instead of 25 kg/cm², enabling handling of low-pressure gas, improving evacuation capability, and enhancing the ultimate recovery and field life of the Bassein reservoir.
Retrofitting of four process gas compressors (PGC – A, B, C, D) with replacement of air coolers, condensate pumps and related piping.
Enhanced production by reducing inlet pressure of separators.
All four PGCs retrofitted with minimal shutdown and taken into operation.
Zero accident / no near-miss – completed with highest HSE standards.
offshoreEpc.project.mol-pumps-bhs.title: Replacement of 02 MOL pumps – BHS platform, ONGC
The project involved replacement of two Main Oil Line (MOL) pumps—P-350 and P-360—out of the existing three-pump system at BHS platform, with new 350 m³/hr capacity pumps, while retaining the third pump (P-370) of 700 m³/hr. The objective was to improve operational reliability and maintain steady crude evacuation through the MOL network.

onshoreEpc.project.nandasan-surface-mehs: Mehsana asset · Oil, gas, effluent, water injection & disposal
Engineering, procurement, dismantling of identified old facilities, installation, hook-up, testing and commissioning of complete surface production, treatment and disposal facilities at Nandasan.
Scope covered oil and gas production, effluent treatment, water injection and water disposal systems, executed on an LSTK basis with end-to-end project management and delivery.
Comprehensive facilities for gas, oil, effluent, water injection and disposal.
Gas production: 2,98,000 SCMD (sales gas, PNGRB quality) and 1,80,000 SCMD (lift gas).
Oil production: 806 m³/day; effluent treatment: 3,200 m³/day meeting PCB norms.
Water injection: 2,100 m³/day and water disposal: 1,100 m³/day.
Successful commissioning of all surface facilities on an LSTK basis.
Enhanced production and environmental compliance (as per PNGRB & PCB).
Integrated multi-stream production with stable throughput.
Zero LTI with strict adherence to HSE standards.
onshoreEpc.project.santhal-air-compresso: Replacement of well injection air compressors
ONGC · Santhal field

Replacement of existing air compressor facilities at Santhal by installing a new high-pressure air compressor plant to ensure continuous availability of HP compressed air for injector wells across the field.
The system comprises five LP centrifugal plus five HP reciprocating compressor trains, delivering air from 0 bar(g) to 128 bar(g), executed within a new dedicated plot area.
Total plant capacity: 16 LSCMD (4 LSCMD × 4 working + 1 standby).
Compressor configuration: LP centrifugal + HP reciprocating trains.
RO water–based cooling system for inter-stage coolers.
Continuous HP air supply for multiple injector wells across the field.
Replacement executed within a new dedicated plot area.
Enhanced reliability and continuous HP air availability across the asset.
Upgraded compression system with improved cooling and operational performance.
Increased uptime supporting seamless field injection requirements.

16 LSCMD

128 bar(g)
LP trains

aboutPage.mission.title: Mission, Vision & Values
aboutPage.mission.lead: Our official mission, vision, and core values — signed 16 September 2026, Mumbai.
aboutPage.mission.missionBody: Our mission, and the essence of our existence, is to identify and realize our customers' future needs, despite the persistently challenging market environment. We will enhance our ability for providing high-quality services from a customer-first perspective toward expanding our business volume as well as achieving sustainable growth for the Group overall and stable returns to shareholders. In addition, we will fulfill our responsibilities as a good corporate citizen and member of society.
aboutPage.mission.visionBody: To make, sell & deliver world-class profitable products and services that satisfy our consumers and deliver sustainable and profitable growth through passionate and empowered associates who are focused on innovation, quality, and efficiency while remaining committed to the environment and community they operate in.

aboutPage.mission.value2.title: Our Innovation

aboutPage.mission.value3.title: Our Integrity

aboutPage.mission.value4.title: Our Workplace

aboutPage.hse.ims.title: Integrated Management System (IMS) Policy
aboutPage.hse.ims.intro: HAL OFFSHORE LIMITED is engaged in Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning and Operation & Maintenance for Oil & Gas EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) and LSTK (Lump-Sum turnkey) projects. We are committed to conducting our business with integrity, responsibility and respect for people, the environment and the communities in which we operate. We are committed to achieving customer satisfaction through high-quality professional project management, engineering, procurement, construction, installation, commissioning and timely completion of projects, while protecting the environment and providing safe and healthy working conditions. HAL OFFSHORE LIMITED shall:
aboutPage.hse.ims.b1: Meet customer requirements and comply with all applicable compliance obligations related to quality, environmental protection, and occupational health & safety (OH&S).
aboutPage.hse.ims.b2: Deliver quality projects on time through effective engineering, project management and quality control.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b3: Eliminate hazards and reduce OH&S risks and environmental impacts.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b4: Provide safe and healthy working conditions to prevent injury and ill health and strive for accident-free project execution.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b5: Provide the necessary competence, training, equipment and resources to meet IMS objectives.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b6: Protect the environment, prevent pollution, minimize environmental impacts, reduce waste and conserve resources.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b7: Ensure effective control of contractors, subcontractors and suppliers so that partners working on our behalf share responsibility for quality, safety and the environment.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b8: Encourage consultation and participation of employees and their representatives in matters affecting OH&S and the environment.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b9: Establish measurable IMS objectives and targets and monitor performance.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b10: Continually improve the effectiveness of the Integrated Management System and overall performance.
aboutPage.hse.ims.b11: Demonstrate Top Management commitment by providing the leadership and resources necessary to implement and maintain the IMS.
aboutPage.hse.quality.title: Quality Policy
aboutPage.hse.quality.intro: We, HAL OFFSHORE LIMITED are in the business of specific Oil & Gas EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) and LSTK (Lump-Sum turnkey) projects. We are committed to satisfy our customers, by offering High-Quality Professional project Management Smooth Project Installation, Commissioning and Timely completion of Projects.
aboutPage.hse.quality.b1: Involvement of our employees and striving for continual improvement in Project Engineering, Project Management Control and Execution.
aboutPage.hse.quality.b2: Continual Improvement of our Engineering Designs, Processes, Quality Control and Assurance Systems.
aboutPage.hse.quality.b3: Complying with applicable Statutory and Regulatory requirements, Safety Norms, applicable International Standards and Codes.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.title: HSE Policy
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.intro: HAL Offshore Ltd.'s activities are undertaken with integrity, responsibility, respect for the health, safety, environment and the community in which these activities take place. This entails conducting operations in an ethically and practically sound manner that minimizes risks and places high priority on the safety of those involved in our ongoing Oil & Gas EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) and LSTK (Lump-Sum turnkey) projects. HAL Offshore Ltd. is committed to:
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b1: Continual improvement of the HSE management system.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b2: Comply with all applicable Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) laws, compliance obligations and standards and to apply responsible standards where legislation is inadequate or does not exist.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b3: Eliminate hazards and reduce OH&S risks.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b4: Develop effective HSE management systems to identify and manage risks associated with its activities by focusing on risk avoidance and prevention.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b5: Establish accountability and responsibility for HSE within HAL Offshore Limited line management.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b6: Provide training, equipment and facilities necessary to maintain a safe and healthy worksite.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b7: Support environmental protection, practice pollution prevention, and seek viable ways to minimize the environmental impact of operations, reduce waste, conserve resources, respect biodiversity and other specific commitments relevant to the context of HAL Offshore Limited.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b8: Ensure that partners and contractors' policies are compliant with our own standards and recognize that all working on our behalf can impact our operation and reputation and that we all share a common responsibility for our safety.
aboutPage.hse.hsePolicy.b9: Consultation and participation of workers, and workers' representatives.
